tasks.title: Google Maps-smooth vehicle dead reckoning — GeoJSON Source+Layer, derive heading from position deltas, route-following DR
tasks.description: Replace DOM markers with GeoJSON Source+Layer for WebGL rendering. Derive heading from position deltas between polls (eliminate routeGeometry dependency). Linear DR fallback using derived heading. Route-following DR using walkRouteForward when geometry available. Reduce polling interval or switch to PocketBase Realtime subscriptions for sub-second updates. Adaptive error blending for seamless position corrections.
